rows.grounds: compound adjective agreeing with pūjā; yathā-labdha (as obtained) + viniṣpādyā (to be accomplished)

items.question: Which grade of worship is accomplished with whatever materials are available?
premises: Worship can be performed using materials as they are obtained.
The materials employed determine a grade of worship.
This verse assigns a specific grade to such worship.
items.inference: Worship performed with materials obtained as available is classified as the middle grade.
items.plain_english: But worship that is performed with whatever materials are available is the middle grade.
